name: Twisted Iron Fabrication LLC
old_description: Welcome to our advanced powder coating services! We've implemented in-house powder coating to maximize efficiency and deliver accurate lead time estimates, putting clear communication and reliability at the core of our customer relationships. Whether you're seeking a full-service project or just the powder coating component, we're ready to meet your needs with confidence. Proudly serving Pittsburgh and the surrounding communities, we’re here to elevate your project!
about:
Twisted Iron Fabrication operates from New Brighton, Pennsylvania, a suburb north of Pittsburgh. The shop serves Western Pennsylvania and extends its reach into Ohio and West Virginia. While the company does not publish a founding date or ownership structure, it presents itself as a custom metal fabrication shop focused on architectural and industrial work.

The shop’s core capabilities center on in-house powder coating, press brake forming, and general metal fabrication. Powder coating was brought in-house to improve efficiency and provide reliable lead-time estimates. Press brake services handle simple and complex bending across mild steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper, and brass. The team also produces architectural railings for residential and commercial projects, as well as fabricated parts and powder-coated components for industrial clients.

Customers span architectural, industrial, trucking, machinery, and signage sectors. Residential and commercial contractors order custom railings and furniture, while industrial buyers request fabricated parts, powder-coated components, and press-brake-formed pieces. The shop also supplies trucking and machinery parts and custom signage, serving a regional footprint that includes Western Pennsylvania, Ohio, and West Virginia.

The company emphasizes clear communication and reliability, citing its move to in-house powder coating as a way to control schedules and deliver accurate lead-time estimates. That operational choice reflects a broader focus on predictable turnaround and straightforward project coordination.
